privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.draftNotice: Draft — this text is placeholder pending review by the hospital's legal counsel and alignment with Egyptian Personal Data Protection Law 151/2020 before publication.

sections.heading: 1. Introduction
sections.body: This Privacy Policy explains how Seashell Hospital collects, uses, and protects your personal data when you use this website, in line with Egyptian Personal Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020 (PDPL).

sections.heading: 2. Data we collect
sections.body: We collect the details you provide through our forms — such as your name, phone number, email, and any information you include in an appointment request, callback request, or message to us.

sections.heading: 3. How we use your data
sections.body: We use your data only to respond to your requests, arrange appointments and callbacks, process payments where applicable, and improve our services. We do not sell your personal data.

sections.heading: 4. Legal basis & consent
sections.body: We process your data on the basis of your consent and to provide the services you request. You may withdraw your consent at any time by contacting us.

sections.heading: 5. Data retention & security
sections.body: We retain personal data only as long as necessary for the purposes described above and apply appropriate technical and organizational safeguards to protect it.

sections.heading: 6. Your rights
sections.body: Under the PDPL you have the right to access, correct, and request deletion of your personal data, and to object to certain processing. To exercise these rights, contact us using the details on our Contact page.

sections.heading: 7. Contact
sections.body: For any privacy question or request, please reach us through the channels listed on the Contact page.

terms.heading: Terms & Conditions
terms.draftNotice: Draft — this text is placeholder pending review by the hospital's legal counsel before publication.

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of terms
sections.body: By using this website you agree to these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use the site.

sections.heading: 2. Use of the website
sections.body: This website provides general information about Seashell Hospital's services and lets you request appointments, callbacks, and payments. You agree to provide accurate information when using our forms.

sections.heading: 3. Not medical advice
sections.body: Content on this website, including the health calculators, is for general information only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a qualified doctor.

sections.heading: 4. Appointments & payments
sections.body: Submitting a request does not confirm an appointment until our team contacts you. Any online payments are handled through our approved payment provider under their terms.

sections.heading: 5. Intellectual property
sections.body: All content on this website is owned by Seashell Hospital or its licensors and may not be reused without permission.

sections.heading: 6. Changes to these terms
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the site after changes means you accept the updated terms.

sections.heading: Beware of fraud
sections.body: Seashell Hospital will never ask you to transfer money to a personal bank account or share your full card details, passwords, or one-time codes over the phone, email, or social media.

sections.heading: Official channels only
sections.body: Only trust appointment, payment, and job-offer communications that come through our official website, hotline, and verified accounts. We never charge fees to apply for a job.

sections.heading: How to verify
sections.body: If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Seashell Hospital, do not respond or pay. Contact us directly through the details on our Contact page to verify before taking any action.

sections.heading: Report it
sections.body: If you believe you have been targeted by a scam using our name, please report it to us immediately so we can help and warn others.
